splus.name: Shen
splus.reason: Less dominant in pure lane, but excellent at protecting a carry, playing the map, and turning cross-map plays.

splus.name: Malphite
splus.reason: Excellent into AD-heavy or fragile drafts. Even with a neutral lane, his ultimate gives a very clear fight condition.

splus.name: Mordekaiser

splus.name: Rammus
splus.reason: Rammus is an excellent answer to AD and auto-attack compositions, but his ranking heavily depends on the enemy draft.

splus.name: Amumu
splus.reason: Amumu is very stable in solo queue: fast clear, simple ganks, and huge ultimate value in grouped fights.

splus.name: Nocturne
splus.reason: Nocturne is very strong at punishing side lanes and creating global pressure, but depends on good targets and clean ultimate timing.
